'''Boarding pods''' were a type of a [[Boarding craft/Legends|boarding craft]] used by various militaries, such as the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]]. Vessels of the [[Eternal Fleet]] carried boarding pods, which were able to dig into the hulls of enemy ships and deploy a contingent of [[Skytrooper]]s.<ref name="SWTOR" />
